how: A batch run of Google Maps (2026-11-24) marked 16 care rows closed. Each was opened again on Maps (the row's query, the local name and the venue around it), then one web search or the place's own site decided: keep (Maps landed on a stale or reseller pin, or the season is already in the row), season (a dated seasonal or temporary closure, now said in the row's why/what in both languages), removed (closed for good or for a rebuild with no date), replaced (the town's only play place gone; a confirmed one of the same kind added).

rows.name: Centreville Amusement Park
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' in November; the 2026 season ran 2 May to 27 September (centreisland.ca event listing, todocanada.ca). The row already says 'summer season only'.

rows.name: Baby Care Centre — Walt Disney Studios Park
rows.evidence: Maps lands on an unclaimed stub (2.2, 'Rest stop', no hours, no website). dlpguide.com still places the room in Front Lot between Studio Services and Studio Photo; the May 2026 move reported by Inside the Magic concerns only Disneyland Park's room.

rows.name: Baby Care Centre (Disneyland Park)
rows.evidence: Maps 'Permanently closed' at 10 Main Street, U.S.A. = the old room. Inside the Magic (6 May 2026): the First Aid and Baby Care Centers on Main Street closed for the Plaza Gardens refurbishment 'through early 2027'; Baby Care moved to the former Annual Passholder office near the ticket booths by the Disneyland Hotel entrance. Row now says where it is for now; q no longer names Main Street.

rows.name: Cotswold Country Park and Beach
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed'. Official admission page: closed for the winter, opens Friday 27 March 2026; season March–September. Winter closure added to why.

rows.name: Imaginosity
rows.evidence: Maps 'Permanently closed' on this very place; imaginosity.ie no longer answers; several listing sites mark it permanently closed. No source shows it open.

rows.name: Asia Plaza Playground
rows.evidence: Maps 'Permanently closed' for Asia Plaza Playground, and the Asia Plaza Supermarket it sat in is also 'Permanently closed'. Siem Reap keeps its other play row.

rows.name: First President's Park
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed'. Kazpravda / nur.kz (2026): the whole park is closed for its first full reconstruction since 2010; the district akim says works end in December, opening put back to spring 2027. Kept with the closure and the planned reopening in why; Almaty keeps another play row. Recheck in spring 2027.

rows.name: Sa Maison Garden
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed'. A dated post (12 June 2026) says the garden 'has been fenced off since last year' for structural restoration of the bastion walls; the government's restoration tender gives no reopening date. Long closure, no date.

rows.name: KLCC Park Playground
rows.evidence: The separate 'KLCC Park Playground' pin says 'Permanently closed' with posting turned off, but the KLCC Park place itself is open today (closes 10 PM) and Maps describes it as offering 'a kids' playground, paths, a wading pool'; no closure reported in 2025–2026 (a May–June 2026 LEGO festival used the park). q now points at KLCC Park so the pin lands on the open place.

rows.name: Amstelpark
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' on Speeltuin Amstelpark. Its own site's banner: 'wij zijn gesloten — 20 feb 2027 weer open' (last winter: closed until 21 Feb). Winter closure added to why.

rows.name: Central Bal Sansar, Civil Mall
rows.evidence: Maps 'Permanently closed' at Civil Mall, Kanti Path, posting turned off. Kathmandu keeps its other play row.

rows.name: Grajsko kopališče Bled
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' in November for the summer lido (kopalisce-bled.si). The row already says 'summer season only'.

rows.name: HarborLand Harbor Pattaya
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' for the whole Harbor Pattaya mall. The Pattaya News (1 Nov 2025): play zones shut from 3 November 2025, every shop by 30 November, for a major renovation; no reopening date found a year on.

rows.name: Blue Tree Adventure Village
rows.evidence: The closed pin is 'Adventure Village Blue Tree (online booking)', a ticket reseller's listing (globaltix.com). Blue Tree Phuket is open today on Maps; phuket101.net (last updated 28 Sep 2026) lists Adventure Village among the current attractions — 'the main reason families come to Blue Tree now' (the lagoon closed in 2024). q now points at Blue Tree Phuket.

rows.name: The Fun Garden
rows.evidence: Maps 'Permanently closed' on this very place, posting turned off. Krabi keeps two play rows.

rows.name: Tiniworld Vincom Plaza Ngo Quyen
rows.evidence: Maps 'Permanently closed' for tiNiWorld in Vincom Plaza Da Nang, posting turned off. It was Da Nang's only play row, so Mikazuki Water Park 365 was added: Maps 'Open · Closes 7 PM' today (Khu du lịch Xuân Thiều, Nguyễn Tất Thành, Hải Vân); its own site: indoor and outdoor spaces, 'Heated water system ensures all-season comfort'; the city's tourism portal: a Kids Pool in the indoor water park and the Ninja Kids Park 'under the dedicated care of the staff'. (Helio Kids was looked at and left out: the tourism portal reports Helio Center suspended for renovation from 5 Sep 2025, reopening not confirmed.)
